_help: Settings for the Amazon Luna app. Edit, save, and the next launch uses them. If this file has a mistake, the app falls back to its built-in settings and says so in /userdata/system/logs/luna-app.log. Sites in 'allowed' are added to the app's built-in list (Luna and Amazon's sign-in are always allowed). Region (start_url), language ('auto' = same as Batocera), volume (0-100), keyboard_highlight, play_intro (true, "daily" or false), intro_volume, intro_muted, game_list ('off', 'all' or 'picked') and dashboard_nav can also be changed on the app's Settings screen: press Menu (Start) on the welcome screen, or use F1 > Applications > Amazon Luna Settings.
